title: How a wind turbine works
author: ar33b98
prompt: explain how a wind turbine works, interactive (use a three-blade horizontal-axis turbine with a geared nacelle). Adjust wind speed, wind direction, and blade pitch angle. Clearly compare power output at cut-in, rated and cut-out speed, with the brake engaging in storm conditions. Show airflow streamlines bending over the blades and the nacelle cutaway (gearbox, generator, yaw motor) using WebGL. Then: select each nacelle component to see its function.
